sheets.title: Settings › Vaults — 1280 × 900
sheets.caption: Before, the Vaults category ended at the vault switcher: the item-type install/remove capability (ADR 0087 §7 — "install and uninstall are data writes … a user can do the same thing at runtime", registered as vault.item_types.install → route:/settings) had no surface at all. The store methods were there and tested; nothing rendered them. After, the Item types panel sits under the switcher: paste a VaultItemType manifest, inspect its fields through the same Source/Visual pair the rest of Settings uses, install it with no reload, and remove it without rewriting the item values it shaped.
sheets.before: panels in Settings › Vaults: 1 (Vaults on this device); item-type rows: 0 — no panel
sheets.after: panels in Settings › Vaults: 2 (Vaults on this device, Item types); item-type rows: 23; remove keys: 23; plus the paste field and the Install type key

sheets.title: Settings › Vaults on a phone — 390 × 844
sheets.caption: The same change at phone width. The panel stacks under the vault list with the same controls in the same order; nothing floats over them and every key keeps its 44px target.
